title: The Taub-NUT Metric Is Not Projectively Induced
summary: LeBrun's Kähler realization $g_m$ of the Taub--NUT metric on $\mathbb{C}^2$ is complete, Ricci-flat and not flat. Loi, Zedda and Zuddas proved that no multiple $αg_m$ admits a Kähler immersion into a finite- or infinite-dimensional complex projective space when $m>α/2$, and conjectured that the same holds for every $m>0$. We prove the conjecture.
